facts.fact: ACSI's general procurement notice of 4 September 2025 lists, from its 2025 investment budget, IT equipment for developing and implementing the PDRCL on behalf of the Ministry of the Interior.
The notice places the PDRCL with the Ministry of the Interior as client and ACSI as buyer.

systems.country_label: Plateforme de dématérialisation des recettes des collectivités locales (PDRCL)
systems.platform: back-office, Zando Collecte field app, public web and mobile interface
systems.owner: ACSI for the Ministry of the Interior

note: Bulletin n° 292 otherwise carries unrelated procurement notices; only the ACSI notice mentions local revenue.
